# A 442 cap in PG(5,7).
# Quantavane, November 2026: found from Edel's 434-cap in PG(5,7) (yvesedel.de, Matritzen/CAPs), in its
# coordinates; 410 of its points are kept (24 removed) and 32 points are new.
# The 442 points are the columns of this 6 x 442 matrix over GF(7), one row per coordinate x0, ..., x5;
# it is a check matrix of a linear [442,436,4]_7 code.
# Field: GF(7), the integers modulo 7, written 0, ..., 6.
# Columns: every point is scaled so that its last nonzero coordinate is 1. Columns 1-410 are the points of
# Edel's cap that are kept, columns 411-442 the new points, each group in lexicographic order of (x0, ..., x5).
